cards.card_text: When the ram's horn sounds, only those perishing in Assyria come forth, and the exiles in Egypt stay behind.
cards.verse_text: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound, and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles in Egypt.

cards.card_text: He tells them, "Let the dying die, and the perishing perish; and let those who remain devour one another’s flesh." Hard words, friend.

cards.verse_text: So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”

cards.card_text: They wake Him: “Master, Master, we are perishing!” No “good morning,” no “sorry to bother You,” they go straight to PERISHING.
cards.verse_text: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters, and they subsided, and all was calm.

cards.card_text: To those who are perishing, what is the message of the cross?
cards.verse_text: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

cards.verse_text: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
